title: ccreality governed paths policy
description: Permissive policy. The deny-on-mismatch gate was removed 2026-05-07 (see scripts/cc/hook_pre_tool_use_edit.sh) so the reality loop can edit any path required to solve the problem. CLAUDE.md still documents which paths Claude SHOULD NOT modify (.env, swebench oracles, reward specs, verifiers); enforcement is now behavioral, not hook-blocking.
